استعرا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَعَرَا (istaʕarā) /is.ta.ʕa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# اُسْتُعِرَا (ustuʕirā) /us.tu.ʕi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# اِسْتَعِرَا (istaʕirā) /is.ta.ʕi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
